name: Hua Nan Financial Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: Hua Nan Financial Holdings Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides financial services in Taiwan and internationally. It operates through Bank, Securities, Insurance, and Other segments. The company provides various banking services, including commercial banking, offshore banking, overseas branch banking, and other banking services. It also engages in the trust business planning, managing, and operating; custody of nondiscretionary trust funds and mutual funds; trading and underwriting of securities; margin loan and securities financing for securities; securities-related auxiliary futures trading; buying and selling of foreign securities; and other securities-related businesses.
